t: Toupret Ready-to-Use Wood Filler in off-white provides a versatile solution for professional wood repair tasks. This high-performance wood filler is suitable for both interior and exterior timber, making it ideal for joiners and carpenters tackling various projects, from repairing skirting boards to exterior window frames. It effectively fills gaps up to 10mm deep on all wood types, including exotic species, chipboard, and plywood. Once cured, typically within 24 hours, the repair can be painted, stained, or varnished with any conventional coating. The filler is also drillable and screwable, ensuring robust and lasting repairs. Easy application and sanding provide a smooth, professional finish with low odour.
b: Ready for Paint & Stain After 24 Hours
